en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a large alpine resort building with arcaded ground floor and wide balconies, set on a hillside with winding paths, benches, meadows, and distant mountains. The reverse has printed captions in Romanian and Russian identifying the location as a rest house in Predeal, a Romanian People's Republic stamp (33 bani, purple) commemorating arts and the 10th anniversary of liberation, and a PREDEAL postmark. Addressed in Romanian with a short handwritten greeting.
